canonical_project: Guangzhou Yungu Phase II Data Center
notes: Guangzhou planning notice lists Yungu Phase II Data Center substation/oil-pit works in Nansha, with project registration 2019190000019806. Guangzhou 2021 key-project plan describes phase II as three data-room buildings, about 73,000 sq m total construction area and 9,000 standard cabinets; no MW disclosed.
